provenance.name: Authored in code by scripts/vehicles/author (models.ts « lamane »): an original design that reads as a large British-style luxury SUV (floating black roof, clamshell bonnet)
provenance.licence: Original work made for this game; no third-party model, texture or photograph is used. The reference photographs only guided proportions and character.
